newsitem.title: CHILE: RTRS - Escondida reports sharply higher copper output.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Escondida reports sharply higher copper output.

text.p: Copper output at Australian-owned Minera Escondida Ltda rose sharply last month to 71,883 tonnes fine copper from 42,567 tonnes in the same month of 1995, Escondida said.
The figures brought production for the first eight months of the year to 560,834 tonnes, up 82 percent from 308,332 tonnes in the same period last year, said Escondida in a statement.
The higher output plainly reflected major expansion at the open pit mine and concentrator in northern Chile's Atacama desert, and at its cathodes plant near Antofagasta.
The August output was comprised of 67,402 tonnes contained in concentrates and 4,481 tonnes in high-grade cathodes.
Production in the first eight months of the year has already surpassed that in all of last year, which came to 466,913 tonnes, said Escondida.
The mine is owned 57.5 percent by Broken Hill Proprietary.
